items.name: iOS lock screen, portrait
items.description: Light iPhone lock-screen banners in the empty dusk sky above a woman on a bench (9:16): a payment, a 10K-views milestone and a message drop in 0.85 s apart. Each new banner lands in front and the older ones tuck behind into a pile, then the pile lifts off the top.

items.name: macOS banners, launch day
items.description: Light Mac notification-centre banners slide in at the top right beside a speaker at her laptop: payment received, a new signup and a deploy, 1.1 s apart. Each one pushes the earlier ones down, then the stack slides back out to the right.

items.name: Android heads-up, order rush
items.description: Dark Android heads-up cards over night footage, top right. Each card has a round icon, an 'App • now' header and an expand chevron. Three orange 'New order' cards arrive 0.8 s apart, then an amber 'Daily goal reached' card, and the oldest card fades once more than three are on screen.
